name: EUVS-Benchmark
description:
Dataset Summary
	

Description: 
  This dataset comprises 104 urban scenes, featuring both extrapolated and interpolated camera poses.

	
		
		Dataset Structure
	

Dataset_structure: 
  For each scene, four main components are:

images: Images of each scene.
sparse: COLMAP format camera poses and sparse point clouds produced by SFM.
training_set.txt: Image names in the training set.
test_set.txt: Image names in the test set.


	
		
		Supported Tasks
	

Supported_tasks: 
  The dataset… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4ce/EUVS-Benchmark.
evaluation_method: PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS (for view synthesis); pose error (degrees) for pose estimation
reputation: A niche academic benchmark for urban scene view synthesis and pose evaluation with modest visibility in the view-synthesis/robotics community.
